text: After this you can explain the four lenses used to assess support decisions.

For education only; this is not legal, purchasing, financial or safety advice. Evaluate a service model from four directions. Service performance covers capability and availability. Flexibility covers changing workload or conditions. Cost-effectiveness compares benefit, total cost and risk. Wider stakeholder effects cover relevant inclusion, environmental or community consequences. An option may improve one area and worsen another; document the trade-offs rather than hiding them.

items: Inferred: A low-cost service may fail during demand peaks. Compare its usual performance, ability to adapt, full costs and relevant wider effects before choosing.

text: Every recommendation considers all four areas before selection.
Show the reasoning behind trade-offs among the four areas.
Where a criterion truly does not apply, explain that decision instead of fabricating a number.
